INSERT INTO employee_access(id,workspace,person,code_hash,expires_at,user_id,email,status,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,NULL,NULL,'Active',?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET code_hash=excluded.code_hash,expires_at=excluded.expires_at,user_id=NULL,email=NULL,status='Active'

INSERT INTO password_accounts(id,workspace,person,login_id,mobile,password_hash,status,must_change,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,'Active',1,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET login_id=excluded.login_id,mobile=excluded.mobile,password_hash=excluded.password_hash,status='Active',must_change=1,updated_at=excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO password_attempts(key,count,reset_at) VALUES(?,1,?) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET count=CASE WHEN reset_at<=? THEN 1 ELSE count+1 END,reset_at=CASE WHEN reset_at<=? THEN excluded.reset_at ELSE reset_at END
INSERT INTO password_sessions(token_hash,account,credential_hash,expires_at) SELECT ?,id,password_hash,? FROM password_accounts WHERE id=? AND password_hash=? AND status='Active'
INSERT INTO workspaces(id,revision,data) VALUES(?,1,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET data=excluded.data,revision=workspaces.revision+1 WHERE workspaces.revision=?
